meta.name: youtube-transcript
meta.description: Fetch and summarize YouTube video transcripts. Use when asked to summarize, transcribe, or extract content from YouTube videos. Handles transcript fetching via residential IP proxy to bypass YouTube's cloud IP blocks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从YouTube视频获取文字内容并快速了解要点
copy.tagline_en: Fetch and summarize YouTube video transcripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to get text content from YouTube videos and quickly grasp key points

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以获取 YouTube 视频的字幕文本，并可选地总结视频内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求总结、转录或提取 YouTube 视频内容时触发。

say.text: 提取这个视频的完整文字稿：dQw4w9WgXcQ
say.note: Claude 会返回带时间戳的完整字幕。

say.text: 用日语字幕转录这个视频：https://youtu.be/xyz789
say.note: Claude 会优先获取日语字幕。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch YouTube video transcripts and optionally summarize the video content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to summarize, transcribe, or extract content from a YouTube video.

say_en.text: Extract the full transcript of this video: dQw4w9WgXcQ
say_en.note: Claude returns full transcript with timestamps.

say_en.text: Transcribe this video with Japanese subtitles: https://youtu.be/xyz789
